page.overview:
Who is Colorful Apatosaurus?

The colorful Apatosaurus is a genetically modified hybrid of Apatosaurus and tree frog that appears in Minecraft Jurassic World.

A colorful variant of the Apatosaurus can be created in the game. In order to create it, a player must acquire 3 samples of Apatosaurus DNA; 2 samples of any Huge DNA; and 1 sample of Tree Frog DNA.
